J=np.array([[0,-1],[1,0]],np.float32)
@torch.no_grad()
def sim(xi,c,wd,bd,lo,hi,M):
    x=torch.tensor(xi); cc=torch.tensor(c); nf=0
    for k in range(20):
        t=torch.full((len(x),),1-k/20)
        v,act=net.velocity(x,t,cc,("blocks.2",),count=False)
        if lo<=k<hi:
            f=(act["blocks.2"].numpy()@wd+bd>0)
            nf+=f
            v=v+torch.tensor(f[:,None]*(x.numpy()@M.T))
        x=x-v/20
    return x.numpy(),nf
